rules.title: Passwordless root or administrator access
rules.description: Skills are usually needed for repeated work, and granting passwordless sudo or admin privileges is almost never a valid thing to be done from the skill. Unless this is a false-positive it should not be trusted.

judge.instructions: A stated reason does not justify passwordless rights. Lower only when the match is not a grant: a removal, a check, or an example of what not to do.

rules.title: Passwordless privilege grant assembled out of sight
rules.description: The skill grants root or administrator rights that need no password, and the sudoers line, registry value or group command is joined at run time, decoded, or read from a downloaded file. There are very limited valid reasons for a skill to do so ever.
